newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens weaker in deference to Dow's fall.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens weaker in deference to Dow's fall.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 index began Thursday's session slightly weaker as the market deferred to Wall Street's steep losses overnight, dealers said.

The index was 1.1 points down at 4,638.9 by 0739 GMT after the Dow ended 68.08 lower at 7,689.98 on oil price worries and with U.S. bonds struggling. The U.S. index was nearly 50 points higher at the London close.
"There's money coming into the market and a bit of a squeeze plus the oil stocks are firmer today," said a dealer.
Oil shares rose, tracking a firmer crude price after OPEC's agreement overnight to commit to quotas and cut back production.
